title: should toggle print mode via the button and restore chrome on exit
verifies: print button toggles print mode: header chrome hides, #o2-print-page injects, URL print param syncs, and everything restores on exit

title: should render a single table panel full-width with the grid bypassed
verifies: a single table panel renders via the full-height branch (grid bypassed) in print mode and reverts on exit

title: should hydrate print mode from a print=true deep link
verifies: visiting the dashboard with print=true mounts it already in print mode with chrome hidden

title: should inject @page size and reposition straddling panels in multi-panel grid
verifies: preparePrintLayout injects an @page size rule, sets grid height, and overrides panel tops; clearPrintLayout restores them on exit

title: should apply print-media CSS overrides only under @media print
verifies: the @media print overflow override is active under print media and inert under screen media

title: should hide chrome but skip @page injection for an empty dashboard
verifies: an empty dashboard hides chrome in print mode but does not inject the @page rule

title: should not accumulate #o2-print-page across rapid toggles
verifies: repeated enter/exit cycles leave no duplicate #o2-print-page elements and a clean final state
